svg.title: Share of Nghệ An farmland meeting each official rule, past years 1995-2024
svg.text: Share of Nghệ An farmland meeting each official rule, past years 1995-2024
Past years, not a forecast. Bar: the share of Nghệ An farmland where the rule's level 1 or higher was met in that year, during the
field dates of the crops of the Nghệ An field trial (R-P02), with the thresholds of QĐ 18/2021/QĐ-TTg (R-A01). n/a: no value.
Farmland: the 5 NASA POWER cells of Nghệ An, weighted by the NASA MODIS farmland mask.

g.text: Drought (rain part), 2 months in a row (Art. 48.1)

svg.text: Source: artifacts/hazard_labels.json, year rows (E-019): NASA POWER daily values (R-N01), NASA MODIS MCD12C1 farmland mask (R-N02),
thresholds of QĐ 18/2021/QĐ-TTg (R-A01). Our computation, not an official record; gridded values smooth extremes.
